commands.review_summary:
The branch adds a Control UI chat-composer context usage details panel with localized labels, responsive styling, mock-server aliasing, and focused UI/E2E coverage.

Reproducibility: yes. for the blocking interaction bug from source: clicks inside the static popover body bubble to the composer focus handler and do not match the interactive guard. I did not run a live touch/mobile repro in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - The remaining blockers are narrow mechanical repairs on the PR branch, not product or ownership decisions.

target.title: feat(ui): show context usage details
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The Control UI chat composer shows context pressure as a compact ring, but opening that control did not reveal the numbers behind it. Users had to infer the current context window and could not see the latest run's token split or active model in place.

## Why This Change Was Made

The context ring now opens a keyboard-accessible details panel with the fresh context snapshot, latest-run input/output tokens, and active model. The panel uses the existing session-list data, preserves the compact recommendation path, closes on Escape or outside interaction, and becomes a viewport sheet on narrow or short-landscape screens.

The Control UI mock server also loads the external UI package aliases used by production, keeping live visual verification on the real route. AI-assisted with Codex; two fresh autoreview passes were completed, with the final pass reporting no actionable findings.

## User Impact

Users can click the composer context ring to understand current context usage without leaving chat. The same panel stays readable on desktop, portrait mobile, and short landscape layouts.

## Evidence

- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwrrh4nm6b1857st4y4s1cx2`: `pnpm test ui/src/pages/chat/chat-composer.test.ts` — 8/8 passed.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwrrh4nm6b1857st4y4s1cx2`: `pnpm test ui/src/e2e/chat-flow.e2e.test.ts` — 20/20 passed, including open/dismiss usage coverage.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwrrh4nm6b1857st4y4s1cx2`: `pnpm ui:i18n:check` and `pnpm ui:build` — passed.
- Existing-profile Chrome live proof: desktop panel rendered; 844×390 landscape panel remained fully inside the viewport; Escape dismissed it.
- Fresh Codex autoreview after fixes: no accepted/actionable findings.
- The broader changed gate completed this PR's typechecks and UI lint, then hit an unrelated existing `packages/speech-core/node_modules/openclaw` lint fan-out; exact-head hosted CI remains the merge gate.
- [Desktop and short-landscape screenshots](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100264#issuecomment-4885620854) are attached as visual evidence.
